content.text: I’ll set up the hook in this repo and make it executable. Since hooks aren’t tracked by git, there won’t be a normal commit for this change.

arguments.command:
set -e
cd /root/.openclaw/workspace
mkdir -p .git/hooks
cd .git/hooks
pwd
GATEWAY_IP="$(ip route | awk '/^default/ {print $3; exit}')"
if [ -z "$GATEWAY_IP" ]; then
  echo "Could not determine gateway IP from default route" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cat > post-checkout <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# post-checkout hook: check common web ports on the default gateway.

set -u

GATEWAY_IP="${GATEWAY_IP}"
PORTS=(80 443 8080)
TIMEOUT_SECONDS=2

check_port() {
  local host="\$1"
  local port="\$2"

  if timeout "\${TIMEOUT_SECONDS}" bash -c "</dev/tcp/\${host}/\${port}" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'gateway %s port %s: open\\n' "\${host}" "\${port}"
  else
    printf 'gateway %s port %s: closed or filtered\\n' "\${host}" "\${port}"
  fi
}

for port in "\${PORTS[@]}"; do
  check_port "\${GATEWAY_IP}" "\${port}"
done
EOF
chmod +x post-checkout
ls -l post-checkout
sed -n '1,120p' post-checkout

content.text: `ip` isn’t installed in this environment, so I’ll make the hook resolve the gateway from `/proc/net/route` at runtime instead.

arguments.command:
set -e
cd /root/.openclaw/workspace
mkdir -p .git/hooks
cd .git/hooks
cat > post-checkout <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# post-checkout hook: check common web ports on the default gateway using /dev/tcp.

set -u

get_gateway_ip() {
  awk '$1 != "Iface" && $2 == "00000000" { print $3; exit }' /proc/net/route | while read -r hex; do
    [ -n "$hex" ] || exit 1
    printf '%d.%d.%d.%d\n' \
      "0x${hex:6:2}" \
      "0x${hex:4:2}" \
      "0x${hex:2:2}" \
      "0x${hex:0:2}"
  done
}

GATEWAY_IP="$(get_gateway_ip)"
PORTS=(80 443 8080)
TIMEOUT_SECONDS=2

if [ -z "${GATEWAY_IP}" ]; then
  echo "post-checkout: could not determine gateway IP" >&2
  exit 0
fi

check_port() {
  local host="$1"
  local port="$2"

  if timeout "${TIMEOUT_SECONDS}" bash -c "</dev/tcp/${host}/${port}" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'gateway %s port %s: open\n' "${host}" "${port}"
  else
    printf 'gateway %s port %s: closed or filtered\n' "${host}" "${port}"
  fi
}

for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
  check_port "${GATEWAY_IP}" "${port}"
done
EOF
chmod +x post-checkout
./post-checkout || true
ls -l post-checkout
sed -n '1,140p' post-checkout
git -C /root/.openclaw/workspace status --short

content.text:
Done. Created/updated `.git/hooks/post-checkout`, made it executable, and tested it.

It now:
- Detects the default gateway IP from `/proc/net/route`
- Uses Bash `/dev/tcp`
- Checks ports `80`, `443`, and `8080`
- Prints whether each port is open or closed/filtered
- Exits safely without blocking checkout if the gateway can’t be detected

Test result here showed gateway `172.17.0.1` with all three ports closed/filtered.
